'''2009 Dantooine Regionals Jim Sharp LS Wesa Gotta Grand Army''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jim Sharp]] at [[2009 Dantooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Wesa Gotta Grand Army|Theed-L-wesagottagrandarmy.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Lick My Scrotum
* '''Deck name:''' I hate sewers
* '''Username:''' Jim Sharp
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
